# 2 Baruch Chapter 55 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** The Cloud and Waters Vision

---

**1** And thereupon the angel Ramiel, who presides over true visions, came to me and said to me:

**2** "Why does your heart trouble you, O Baruch, and why are you disturbed at the sight of this vision?"

**3** "For if you are troubled because of what you have heard about the last times, hear also what has been decreed concerning you."

**4** "For you shall be preserved until that time, even the end of the times."

**5** And I, Baruch, answered and said to him: "Tell me then the interpretation of this vision, so that I may know what I see."

**6** And Ramiel the angel said to me: "I will explain to you also the interpretation of the vision which you have seen, since you have been chosen for this."

**7** "Hear therefore the interpretation of the black and the bright waters which you have seen, and you will know what has been decreed for you at the last times."

**8** "For many things have been said to you above, and many things have been shown to you, because you are righteous and obedient to the fear of the Mighty One."

---

*LOGOS notes: Formal equivalence rendering from the Syriac (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1). Paragraph divisions follow the sense units of the source.*
